figure.name: Sarah Bernhardt
figure.breakdown: Sarah Bernhardt toured more like a head of state than a player: when she sailed for New York in 1891 the crossing was covered the way a royal visit is, and 'Divine Sarah' was by then the whole public's phrase for her. Mark Twain's note put it exactly - there were five kinds of actresses, and Sarah Bernhardt. An idol built at distance.
